text:
nina: Heads up0hrs ago I noticed the cost widget example in the dashboard quickstart shows tokens in ms units (looks wrong). Repro steps: open sample dashboard > Cost by route widget > unit shows "ms".
ben: hmm that's probably a copy-paste from the latency example. which file is the snippet in?
nina: docs/console/dashboards/widgets/cost-by-route.md (line ~42 in the built html).
sam: I can patch the snippet to use `cost_units: "tokens"` and add a short note about billing units (tokens vs seconds). Want me to also add a tiny code sample showing how to convert tokens->dollars with the pricing table?
alejandra: please yes add the conversion snippet but keep it annotation-only (not a full price calculator). Also, make sure the widget JSON in the example uses the new field `metric_unit` (we renamed it in the dashboard schema).
nina: also theres an unrelated tracing hook sample in the same doc that references `trace_id_hex` but our SDK uses `tracehex` in the latest release. CI didn't catch it because the snippet is fenced as plain text.
docs-ci-bot: snippet-lint: codeblock format mismatch at docs/console/dashboards/widgets/cost-by-route.md:43
docs-ci-bot: linkcheck: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/dashboards/widgets#cost-by-route -> OK
sam: pushing branch `docs/3499-cost-widget-fix` with two tiny commits: fix unit label in the rendered snippet, update schema property to `metric_unit`, and replace `trace_id_hex` -> `tracehex` in the tracing example. Draft of the conversion note:
```js
// rough conversion shown for illustration only
const tokens = 1200
const pricePerToken = 0.0000025 // example
console.log((tokens * pricePerToken).toFixed(6) + ' USD')
```
ben: can you also add a one-line QA checklist item to confirm widget previews in the Console UI match the doc snippet? we've had drift before.
sam: added checklist item and set up a quick manual preview step. I also toggled the widget preview flag in staging to verify the label.
alejandra: pinging runtime-team for a quick sanity check on the `tracehex` rename; if any client still ships `trace_id_hex` we'll need a compatibility note. @runtime-team?
nina: thanks. once CI passes I'll merge and backport to the 1.2 docs branch. small note: let's avoid changing other docs in the same PR to keep the backport clean. :slightly_smiling_face:
docs-ci-bot: CI updated: docs lint OK, linkcheck OK, snippet-lint warning fixed in latest push.
ben: LGTM pending staging preview. thanks team! :rocket:
